parrafo_1.es: CARS DOCTOR LLC atiende W Flagler St desde su taller equipado con elevadores, alineadora de ruedas y equipo de diagnóstico computarizado. Trabajamos frenos, cambio de aceite, aire acondicionado, suspensión, dirección, alternadores y arranque, en carros, SUV y camionetas de cualquier marca.
parrafo_1.en: CARS DOCTOR LLC works out of a fully equipped shop on W Flagler St, with lifts, a wheel alignment rack and computer diagnostic equipment. We handle brakes, oil changes, A/C, suspension, power steering, alternators and starters, on cars, SUVs and trucks of any make.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes lo dicen mejor que nosotros: en una reseña reciente, Tomas revisó unos frenos, vio que los discos todavía estaban bien y los devolvió en vez de cobrar por algo innecesario. Esa honestidad es la razón por la que tantos clientes llevan años volviendo.
parrafo_2.en: Our customers say it better than we can: in one recent review, Tomas inspected a customer's brakes, found the discs were still fine, and returned them instead of charging for something unnecessary. That honesty is why so many customers keep coming back year after year.

titulo.es: Llama o pasa por el taller

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué le pasa a tu carro al (786) 536-2536. Respondemos directo, sin intermediarios.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your car at (786) 536-2536. We answer directly, no middlemen.

texto.es: Revisamos el problema de raíz antes de tocar nada. Si una pieza todavía sirve, te lo decimos en vez de cambiarla sin necesidad.
texto.en: We check the problem at its root before touching anything. If a part still works, we tell you instead of replacing it just to make a sale.

texto.es: Frenos, aceite, A/C, suspensión o alineación, con aceites Castrol y repuestos de calidad, en los elevadores del taller.
texto.en: Brakes, oil, A/C, suspension or alignment, using Castrol oils and quality parts, right on the shop's lifts.

titulo.en: You leave knowing what you paid for

texto.es: Te explicamos lo que se hizo y por qué, sin cobros sorpresa ni piezas cambiadas de más.
texto.en: We explain what was done and why, with no surprise charges and no parts swapped out that did not need it.

nota.es: Cada reparación se diagnóstica primero y te explicamos el costo antes de empezar. Llama o pasa por el taller para una cotización.
nota.en: Every repair is diagnosed first, and we walk you through the cost before any work begins. Call or stop by the shop for a quote.

texto.es: Pastillas, discos, amortiguadores y dirección. Si una pieza todavía sirve, te lo decimos antes de cambiarla.
texto.en: Pads, rotors, shocks and steering components. If a part still has life left, we tell you before replacing it.

texto.es: Cambio de aceite y filtro con Castrol, el mismo que usamos en todos los carros que pasan por el taller.
texto.en: Oil and filter change using Castrol, the same oil we run through every car that comes through the shop.

texto.es: Diagnóstico y reparación de A/C. Nuestros clientes destacan lo honesto del diagnóstico antes de recomendar un cambio de pieza.
texto.en: A/C diagnostics and repair. Customers specifically call out how honest the diagnosis is before any part gets recommended for replacement.

texto.es: Alineación de ruedas y diagnóstico computarizado para Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi y cualquier otra marca.
texto.en: Wheel alignment and computer diagnostics for Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi and every other make.

pie.es: ¿Necesitas otro servicio para tu carro? Llámanos y lo conversamos.
pie.en: Need something else done to your car? Call us and we will talk it through.

items.quote: Great experience with Car Doctor! I called toward the end of the day, almost at closing time, because I needed brake service, and they were extremely attentive, polite, and helpful from the start. What impressed me the most was their honesty: Tomas, after inspecting the car, realized the brake discs didn't need to be replaced, so they returned them instead of charging me for something unnecessary.

I've been going to this car shop for a couple of years and I definitely won't change my car shop of trust. They always give good service and use quality oils, filters and other supplies. They have really good knowledge of mechanical practice. Totally recommended for anyone who wants quality and fair prices.

I was referred by a friend to go see Tomas, he is the A/C mechanic. The service is excellent, their experience and knowledge is excellent too, and they are very honest. They did a diagnostic on my car and explained everything, and they were not only able to resolve my problem right on the spot but also saved me money by not overcharging for a part that did not need to be changed.
